episodes.synopsis: Demon King Ahriman wants to take over the world but his daughter Doux is too kind and making it difficult.
episodes.title: The Demon King's Daughter Is Too Kind!! / The Demon King's Daughter Helps Too Much!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi tries to get Doux to hate humans by making her meet a demon hunter.
episodes.title: The Demon King's Daughter Must Shrewdly Oppress the Humans!! / The Demon King's Advisor Teaches Too Well!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi tries to assist Doux in getting a familiar and Doux gains a new teacher.
episodes.title: Searching for a Familiar Is Too Difficult!! / The Pairika Is Too Sexy!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi comes up with a plan to capture Santa Claus but Doux just wants to help Santa hand out presents.
episodes.title: Santa Is Handing Out Too Many Presents!! / The Demon King's Familiar Loves Humans Too Much!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi has a new plan to get Doux to become more demon like, but a divine messenger gets in the way.
episodes.title: The Divine Messenger Is Too Much Trouble!! / The Divine Messenger (The Real One) Is Too Hot-Headed!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi teaches Doux how to transform and Thaiti tries to find the perfect job.
episodes.title: The Demon King's Daughter Is Trying to Change Her Image Too Much!! / XXX Is Too Perfect a Job for a Pairika!!

episodes.synopsis: Doux encounters some monsters of terror and Doux, the demon king, and Jahi go on vacation.
episodes.title: The Monsters of Terror Look Too Ugly!! / The Spirit Tower Is Just Too Exciting!! / The Demon King's Attendant Thinks Too Much!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi is dealing with a few problems and Doux tries to help.
episodes.title: The Demon King's Attendant Is Too Depressed!! / The Demon King's Attendant Is Too Tired!!

episodes.synopsis: The previous demon king, who is known to be scary, comes to visit. Is he immune to Doux's charms?
episodes.title: The Previous Demon King Is Too Scary!! / The Previous Demon King Is Too Much of a Doting Grandpa!!

episodes.synopsis: Jahi asks a witch to make a potion to turn Doux evil and later on, Doux runs into a hero.
episodes.title: The Witches' Potions Work Way Too Good!! / The Hero Is Just Too Unreliable!!

episodes.synopsis: Doux's face reveal ceremony is coming soon and she gets a surprise visitor.
episodes.title: The Demon King's Wife Loves Her Daughter Too Much!! / The Face Reveal Ceremony Is Too Soon!!

episodes.synopsis: Doux has her big Face Reveal Ceremony.
episodes.title: The Face Reveal Ceremony Is Too Lively!! / The Future Demon King Is Too Kind!!
